ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\square ABCD$, $\triangle ACE$ is constructed with $AC$ as the hypotenuse, and $\angle BED$ is a right angle. Prove that: $\square ABCD$ is a rectangle.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution.} Proof: Connect OE\\
$\because$ quadrilateral ABCD is a parallelogram,\\
$\therefore$ AO=CO, BO=DO.\\
$\because$ $\angle$AEC=$\angle$BED=90$^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ AC=2OE, BD=2OE,\\
$\therefore$ AC=BD,\\
$\therefore$ $\square ABCD$ is a \boxed{rectangle}.

method.method_draft: Use the midpoint-of-hypotenuse theorem. From the image, note that ABCD is a parallelogram-like quadrilateral with diagonals AC and BD intersecting at O, and E is joined to A, C, B, and D. From the text, read that AC is the hypotenuse of right triangle ACE, so angle AEC is 90°, and that angle BED is also 90°. Since ABCD is a parallelogram, its diagonals bisect each other, so O is the midpoint of both AC and BD. In right triangle ACE, the midpoint O of hypotenuse AC is equidistant from A, C, and E, hence OE = AC/2. In right triangle BED, the midpoint O of hypotenuse BD is equidistant from B, D, and E, hence OE = BD/2. Therefore AC = BD. A parallelogram with equal diagonals is a rectangle, so ABCD is a rectangle.

method.method_draft: Use a coordinate/vector formulation centered at O. From the image, take O as the intersection of diagonals AC and BD. Since ABCD is a parallelogram, O is the common midpoint of the two diagonals. Assign vectors A = p, C = -p, B = q, D = -q, and E = e with origin at O. From the text, triangle ACE is right at E because AC is its hypotenuse, so (A - E) · (C - E) = 0. Substituting gives (p - e) · (-p - e) = 0, hence |e|^2 = |p|^2. Also angle BED is right, so (B - E) · (D - E) = 0. Substituting gives (q - e) · (-q - e) = 0, hence |e|^2 = |q|^2. Therefore |p| = |q|, so AC = 2|p| and BD = 2|q| are equal. Since ABCD is a parallelogram with equal diagonals, ABCD is a rectangle.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中 ABCD 是一个平行四边形，A 在左上方，B 在左下方，C 在右下方，D 在右上方；对角线 AC 与 BD 相交于点 O。点 E 位于平行四边形下方，图中连接了 AE、CE，并且还连接了 BE、DE。题设说明 AC 是三角形 ACE 的斜边，所以 ∠AEC=90°；题设还说明 ∠BED=90°。

推理：以图中两条对角线 AC、BD 的交点 O 为原点建立向量表示。因为 ABCD 是平行四边形，所以 O 是两条对角线的共同中点，即 AO=CO，BO=DO。设点 A、C、B、D、E 的位置向量分别为 p、-p、q、-q、e。

因为 AC 是 △ACE 的斜边，所以 ∠AEC=90°，于是 EA 与 EC 垂直，即 (A-E)·(C-E)=0。代入向量得 (p-e)·(-p-e)=0。展开： (p-e)·(-p-e)= -|p|^2+|e|^2，因此 |e|^2=|p|^2。

又因为 ∠BED=90°，所以 EB 与 ED 垂直，即 (B-E)·(D-E)=0。代入向量得 (q-e)·(-q-e)=0。展开： (q-e)·(-q-e)= -|q|^2+|e|^2，因此 |e|^2=|q|^2。

由 |e|^2=|p|^2 且 |e|^2=|q|^2，得到 |p|=|q|。而 AC=|p-(-p)|=2|p|，BD=|q-(-q)|=2|q|，所以 AC=BD。

平行四边形的两条对角线相等，则该平行四边形是矩形。因此 ABCD 是矩形。

由 ∠BED=90°，得 (q-e)·(-q-e)=0，故 |e|^2=|q|^2。

因此 |p|=|q|，从而 AC=2|p|=2|q|=BD。平行四边形对角线相等，所以 ABCD 是矩形。

因为 AC 是 △ACE 的斜边，所以 ∠AEC=90°，于是 EA 与 EC 垂直，即 (A-E)·(C-E)=0。代入向量得 (p-e)·(-p-e)=0。展开： (p-e)·(-p-e)= -|p|^2+|e|^2，因此 |e|^2=|p|^2。

又因为 ∠BED=90°，所以 EB 与 ED 垂直，即 (B-E)·(D-E)=0。代入向量得 (q-e)·(-q-e)=0。展开： (q-e)·(-q-e)= -|q|^2+|e|^2，因此 |e|^2=|q|^2。

由 |e|^2=|p|^2 且 |e|^2=|q|^2，得到 |p|=|q|。而 AC=|p-(-p)|=2|p|，BD=|q-(-q)|=2|q|，所以 AC=BD。

平行四边形的两条对角线相等，则该平行四边形是矩形。因此 ABCD 是矩形。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, in $\square ABCD$, $\triangle ACE$ is constructed with $AC$ as the hypotenuse, and $\angle BED$ is a right angle. Prove that $\square ABCD$ is a rectangle.
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution.} Proof: Connect OE\\
$\because$ quadrilateral ABCD is a parallelogram,\\
$\therefore$ AO=CO, BO=DO.\\
$\because$ $\angle AEC=\angle BED=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ AC=2OE, BD=2OE,\\
$\therefore$ AC=BD,\\
$\therefore$ $\square ABCD$ is a \boxed{rectangle}.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure ABCD is drawn in the shape of a parallelogram, A is at the upper left, B is at the lower left, D is at the upper right, C is at the lower right; diagonals AC and BD intersect at point O. Point E is located below and to the right of the quadrilateral, and in the figure E is connected with A, C, B, D, forming triangle ACE and triangle BED.

Reasoning: According to the problem, ABCD is a parallelogram, so its two diagonals bisect each other, therefore O is the midpoint of AC and also the midpoint of BD, that is AO=CO, BO=DO. Also because triangle ACE has AC as the hypotenuse, ∠AEC=90°; in right triangle ACE, the midpoint O of hypotenuse AC has equal distances to the three vertices A, C, E, therefore OE=AC/2. The problem also gives ∠BED=90°, so triangle BED is a right triangle, and BD is its hypotenuse; and O is the midpoint of BD, therefore by the hypotenuse midpoint theorem, OE=BD/2. Thus AC/2=OE=BD/2, so AC=BD. If the two diagonals of a parallelogram are equal, then this parallelogram is a rectangle. Therefore □ABCD is a rectangle.
